entries.reason: The attribute remainder follows the element's own record, and a run has none on the editor side: a run is text plus marks, so a run-level attribute would have to ride a non-exclusive inline mark that does not exist yet. The model holds the remainder and a save writes it, so only a round trip through the editor drops it. A paragraph, a row and a section keep theirs, which is why the paragraph-owned rows stay defects: the four patterns claim only positions that hold runs, so `document.content[].preservedAttributes` and a cell's `cells[].content[].preservedAttributes` are untouched.
entries.removalCondition: A non-exclusive inline mark that carries a run's attribute remainder through the ProseMirror projection. `r|CT_R`'s three pairs sit at `dropped (editorProjection)` until it exists; once it does these rows go to zero and this entry is deleted rather than re-measured.
